Title: Newbie (well back from the grave) question

Messages.Author: Thurgood
Messages.Body:
ok, this may be really dumb but I just don't knwo the answer. Back in the
day I played Jyhad and liked it a lot, the problem was no one else in my
area seemed to so I lost interest. Now I've found some people and might get
some games going. My question is, what is the difference between Jyhad and
Vampire? Are they the same game or different? Are Jyhad cards usable with
Vampire cards? Any info would be appreciated.

thanks

thurgood

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


The games are the same (well, the rules are updated, but they've been
updated a few times since the VTES name change anyhow).

The cards are compatible.

Note: many cards have been reprinted with clarified and sometimes
functionally different card texts. Most recent printings for all
cards is available on the web site (see .sig).
